text: We beseech Thee, O holy Lord, almighty Father, eternal God, that He may render our sacrifice acceptable to Thee, Who, by giving it to His disciples on this day, taught them that it is done in commemoration of Him, Jesus Christ, Thy Son, our Lord. Who with Thee.
